risks.description: WC product loop vs static product.html
risks.detail: v8 catalog.html has 22 static hardcoded products. In WP, products come from WC DB. The archive-product.php must use WC loop (dynamic) but style cards identically to v8 static cards. Product data (images, prices, descriptions) must be in WC DB.
risks.mitigation: Keep WC loop in archive-product.php. Update template-parts/product-card.php to v8 visual style. WC products must be populated in WP admin before wave_4.

risks.description: Calculator JS — 6 categories with inline PRODUCTS array
risks.detail: v8 calculator.html has ~200 lines of JS with a hardcoded PRODUCTS array (6 categories, real prices). In WP, this could be (a) inline JS in page-calculator.php, (b) moved to assets/js/main.js with wp_localize_script() for dynamic prices, or (c) kept as static array.
risks.mitigation: Recommendation: keep inline JS in page-calculator.php for simplicity. If WC products exist, load prices via wp_localize_script(). Fallback: static PRODUCTS array.

risks.detail: front-page.php uses 4 template-parts (hero, features, category-grid, lead-form). If one is updated and others not, page will look broken. All 4 must be updated in same wave.
risks.mitigation: Wave 2 (P1-front-page) updates all 4 template-parts + front-page.php + product-card.php together.

risks.description: Category grid: static vs WC terms
risks.detail: v6 category-grid.php uses WC get_terms() for dynamic categories. v8 home-v8.html has 4 static categories with hardcoded images. Decision: keep dynamic (WC terms) but add fallback images.
risks.mitigation: Keep WC get_terms() in category-grid.php. Add Customizer fields for category images. Fallback: v8 static images if no WC terms configured.

risks.description: Footer: static categories vs WC terms
risks.detail: v6 footer.php uses WC get_terms() for footer catalog links. v8 footer has 5 static links (Брусчатка, Плитка, Бордюры, Памятники, Эко-парковка). Decision: use static v8 links (real categories).
risks.mitigation: Hardcode 5 category links in footer.php matching v8. These are the real product categories.

risks.detail: v6 uses JetBrains Mono for prices, stats numbers, tabular-nums. v8 has no monospace font. Prices and numbers use font-body (Source Serif 4).
risks.mitigation: Remove all font-mono references. Replace with font-body or font-display as appropriate per v8.

risks.detail: v6 uses .steel-divider (3px gradient bar) as brand signature. v8 has no divider. Removing it changes visual identity.
risks.mitigation: Remove .steel-divider from functions.php, tailwind/input.css, and all PHP templates. Replace with simple border-t where needed.

risks.detail: v6 uses border-2 (2px) consistently. v8 uses border (1px). This is a global change affecting 50+ class strings across all files.
risks.mitigation: Systematic find-and-replace: border-2 → border in all .php files. Verify no unintended changes.

risks.detail: v6 uses rounded-md (6px), rounded-lg (12px). v8 uses rounded-2xl (16px) consistently. Global find-and-replace needed.
risks.mitigation: Systematic find-and-replace: rounded-md → rounded-2xl, rounded-lg → rounded-2xl in all .php files. Verify no unintended changes.
